profile.name: Cytomat 自动化孵育存储柜
profile.description: 一种用于微孔板（MTP）自动化存储与孵育的立式设备。包含可开关的舱门、内部货架/存储位、传输站（transfer station）和可伸缩的取放装置（铲/移载机构），并配有条码读取、摇床（振荡器）以及温度、CO₂、湿度和 O₂ 等环境传感与控制能力，常用于自动化实验室中板材的存取、临时暴露以及长期孵育保存。
profile.description_en: A vertical automated plate hotel/incubator for microplates (MTP). The unit provides door-controlled compartments, stacked storage racks, a transfer station for external robots, and an internal shuttle/shovel mechanism to move plates between storage, wait and exposed positions. It typically includes barcode reading, shaker modules, and environmental sensors/controls for temperature, CO2, humidity and O2 for automated storage and incubation workflows.
